history.text: An express train collides with a stationary car near the village of Ufton Nervet, England, killing seven and injuring 120.
history.title: Ufton Nervet rail crash

culture.text: In New Brunswick, New Jersey, Rutgers College defeats Princeton University (then known as the College of New Jersey), 6–4, in the first official intercollegiate American football game.
culture.title: New Brunswick, New Jersey
